notes: ACCESS: potterybarn.com still answers Akamai 403 to plain requests, to r.jina.ai (the route the prior Home-Decor pass used - it 403s now) and to WebFetch. Two routes did work this session: (a) curl_cffi impersonation - a 12-profile sweep found chrome124, safari15_5/17_0/18_0, safari17_2_ios/18_0_ios and firefox133 all returning 200 full HTML (chrome110/116/120/131 and edge101 timed out); (b) the local Chrome browser, which renders the SPA. robots.txt was checked first: no anthropic-ai / ClaudeBot / Claude-Web directive, only EasouSpider plus path rules. TREE: taken from Pottery Barn's own mega-menu data, window.__INITIAL_STATE__.shop.categories on the /shop/furniture/, /shop/outdoor/ and /shop/bath/ landing pages (its 'header' entries are the grouping rows here, its 'subcat' entries the leaves), cross-checked against the shop sitemap (netstorage/sitemaps/shop-sitemap-1.xml.gz, 794 category URLs, served unprotected) and against the Constructor.io group tree. The taxonomy really is two levels deep: the breadcrumbs API (/api/catalog/v1/category/breadcrumbs/...) returns Home > Furniture > <leaf> for every node checked, so there is no deeper level to walk. QTY: PB's PLP is client-rendered and its served HTML carries no count, so every number here is the value the page's own product query returns - Constructor.io browse total_num_results for that group_id (key_w3v8XC1kGR9REv46, read from shop.searchEngineConfig.constructorKey). That equivalence was proved, not assumed: on 15 categories spread across all three departments (Sofas 424, Chairs 690, Sectional Sofas 1433, Dressers & Armoires 183, Storage Cabinets & Shelves 48, Game Tables 19, office Bookcases & Shelves 236, Benches 77, Makeup Vanities 1, Electric Fireplaces 4, Entryway 382, Bath Vanities 192, Medicine Cabinets 13, Outdoor Side Tables 51, Outdoor Dining Sets 24) the page was loaded in a real browser and the rendered 'N Items' header under the H1 matched total_num_results exactly, and also matched the app store value shop.cat.response.numFound. Each of those URLs was confirmed to render its own H1 (no silent parent substitution - the invented slug /shop/furniture/living-room-furniture/sofas/ does silently serve the parent 'All Living Room Furniture', which is why every link here uses PB's real group-id slug). The full set was read twice with zero drift. CAUTION recorded: the Constructor *group-tree* node counts (fmt_options[groups_max_depth]) are NOT the same numbers - Bath Vanities reads 193 there against 192 rendered - so only the direct total_num_results was used. EXCLUDED and why: view-all/aggregate nodes (All Furniture, All Living Room, All Bedroom, All Dining, All Home Office, All Storage & Modular, All Bath Furniture, All Outdoor Furniture, All Outdoor Lounge/Dining, Dining Chairs & Stools); marketing collections (Sofa & Sectional Collections, Bedroom/Dining/Home Office/Modular Storage Collections, Furniture Collections Across the Home and every named collection under them); material and upholstery filter shops (Leather Furniture 849, Slipcovered Furniture 615, and the outdoor Teak / Metal / All-Weather Wicker / Wood / Mixed Material / Concrete / Cushion-less shops); in-stock and small-space filter shops; Build Your Own Sectionals (configurator, overlaps Sectional Sofas); the entire Contract Grade trade programme (Contract Grade Furniture 3360 etc., a commercial-use re-cut of the same catalogue that would double-count); New Arrivals, Bestsellers, Sale, Outlet, Collaborations, Design Resources and the secret AITC shops. Out of scope by product type: Mattresses & Box Springs and Box Springs & Bed Bases (bedding), Dining Seat Cushions and all outdoor cushions/covers (textiles), fabric/wood/metal/countertop swatches, Replacement Slipcovers and Furniture Care & Touch-Up Kits (care/parts), Patio Umbrellas & Stands, Fire Pits & Patio Heaters, Pots & Planters, gardening, outdoor dinnerware/serveware/drinkware, games, front-door hardware, and all Bath fixtures/hardware/lighting/linens. Bath Medicine Cabinets (13, rendered count verified) were dropped deliberately: PB files them under 'Mirrors & Medicine Cabinets' rather than Bath Furniture and the tiles are inset mirrored wall cabinets, which is Wall Decor / fixture territory. Closets by Hold Everything, Reach-In Closets and Walk-In Closets are nav entries whose group_ids return 0 products (design-service landing pages), so they are not listing categories. The Organization department was inspected and contributes nothing unique: its furniture entries (Bookcases & Shelves, Storage Cabinets, Entryway Storage, Storage Benches & Ottomans, All Storage Furniture) are link-outs to the Furniture department nodes already listed, and its own subcats are baskets, bins, hooks, luggage and wall shelves. 'Ottomans, Stools & Poufs' (334) is emitted as a grouping row because its children Ottomans (218) and Stools (84) are separate listings; PB has no separate Poufs node. Pottery Barn Kids, Teen and Baby are separate domains and were not touched.
